name: Mejorada (Spain)
description: Quartered blue and white with blue at the upper hoist.
history: The flag is a rectangular cloth of proportion 2:3, quartered alternately azure and argent so that the upper hoist quarter is azure; the arms and flag were proposed by the heraldists and historians José Luis Ruz Márquez and Buenaventura Leblic García on the commission of the town council of 30 September 1982.
